payload.outcome: Fixed in PR #2887 (merged 2026-09-18). The one-line rail contract could not be relaxed — tests/ui-overlap.spec.ts pins chipRows === 1 and tests/search-route-ownership.test.ts reads globals.css for flex-wrap: nowrap — so the fix keeps the single line and adds a discoverable affordance instead: edge scroll controls in answer-suggestion-chips.tsx, rendered per direction only on real overflow, absolutely positioned so a 48px target never enters the 32px rail's flow, and a sibling of the chip list rather than a child because ui-overlap counts that list's children. Proven at the reported width by a new 820x1180 describe block in ui-overlap.spec.ts, with the existing 1280/1920 one-line contract still passing.
